questions.question: 12-Factor App metodologiyasini va har faktor zamonaviy Kubernetes'ga qanday mos kelishini tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: Codebase: har mikroservisga bitta Git repo; dev/staging/prod'ga GitOps orqali.

questions.question: Immutable infrastructure nima va operatsion foydasi?
questions.explanation: Server va container'lar joyida patch qilinmaydi: yangilash = yangi image yasash, test qilish, deploy qilish va eskisini o'chirish.

questions.question: DR'da RTO va RPO farqini aniq ssenariy bilan tushuntiring.
questions.explanation: RTO (Recovery Time Objective): avariyadan keyin servis tiklanguncha ruxsat etilgan maksimal downtime.

questions.question: To'rtta asosiy cloud DR strategiyasini solishtiring.
questions.explanation: [ Lowest Cost / Highest RTO & RPO ]                                [ Highest Cost / Near-Zero RTO & RPO ]

questions.question: Distributed tizimlarda Bulkhead pattern nima?
questions.explanation: Kritik resurslarni (thread pool, connection pool, xotira) har downstream dependency uchun alohida bo'limlarga ajratish — bitta dependency yiqilsa, u butun resursni tugatib ilovani yiqita olmaydi.

questions.question: Circuit breaker nima va uning uchta holati?
questions.explanation: Doimiy fail bo'layotgan operatsiyani qayta-qayta chaqirishning oldini oluvchi pattern:

questions.question: Jitter bilan exponential backoff nima?
questions.explanation: Retry kutish vaqti har urinishda ikki baravar oshadi (2^n) va unga tasodifiy farq (jitter) qo'shiladi — client'lar retry'larini sinxron qilmaydi va thundering herd / retry storm oldi olinadi.

questions.question: Zero-downtime DB migration uchun Expand and Contract pattern nima?
questions.explanation: Expand: yangi ustun/jadvalni backward-compatible qo'shish (nullable yoki default bilan).

questions.question: Chaos engineering nima va GameDay qanday o'tkaziladi?
questions.explanation: Production/staging'ga nazoratli nosozliklar kiritish (pod o'ldirish, latency qo'shish, DB ulanishini uzish) — yashirin tizimli zaifliklarni topish uchun.

questions.question: SRE'da toil nima va qanday yo'qotiladi?
questions.explanation: Qo'lda bajariladigan, takroriy, avtomatlashtirsa bo'ladigan va doimiy qiymat yaratmaydigan operatsion ish. Google SRE 50% qoidasi: toil SRE vaqtining 50% idan oshmasin, qolgani toil'ni butunlay avtomatlashtiradigan mu...

questions.question: SLO error budget policy nima?
questions.explanation: Rasmiy kelishuv: error budget 0% ga tushsa feature deploy'lar muzlatiladi va muhandislik resursi to'liq reliability va bug fix'ga o'tadi.

questions.question: FinOps unit cost economics nima?
questions.explanation: Cloud xarajatini biznes metrikasiga nisbatan o'lchash (aktiv foydalanuvchi uchun xarajat, tranzaksiya uchun xarajat) — hisob o'sishi sog'lom o'sishdanmi yoki arxitektura samarasizligidanmi, aniqlanadi.

questions.question: Kubernetes'da pod anti-affinity nima?
questions.explanation: Bir xil ilova replikalarini turli node va turli Availability Zone'larga tarqatish uchun scheduling qoidasi — high availability uchun (zamonaviy alternativa: topologySpreadConstraints).

questions.question: Rate limiting va load shedding farqi.
questions.explanation: Rate limiting: alohida client trafigini token/IP bo'yicha cheklaydi (masalan, foydalanuvchiga 100 req/min).

questions.question: Blameless post-mortem madaniyati nima?
questions.explanation: Inson xatosini shaxsiy aybsizlik emas, chuqurroq tizim/jarayon/tooling zaifligi alomati deb ko'rish; takrorlanmaslik uchun aniq muhandislik himoyalariga e'tibor.

questions.question: Trunk-based development nima?
questions.explanation: Barcha dasturchilar kichik commit'larni kuniga bir necha marta bitta umumiy branch'ga (main) merge qiladi; uzoq yashovchi feature branch va merge conflict'lardan qochiladi (tugallanmagan ish feature flag ortida).

questions.question: Shift-left testing va security nima?
questions.explanation: Unit test, SAST, SCA va compliance tekshiruvlarini dev siklining eng erta bosqichiga olib kelish — defekt eng arzon tuzatiladigan paytda topiladi.

questions.question: Dark launching va canary deployment farqi.
questions.explanation: Canary: yangi versiya real foydalanuvchilarning kichik foiziga ko'rsatiladi.

questions.question: DevOps automation'da idempotency nima?
questions.explanation: Operatsiyani bir yoki ko'p marta bajarish ham bir xil yakuniy holatni beradi, kutilmagan side effect'siz (terraform apply, ansible-playbook).

questions.question: High availability va "nines" nima?
questions.explanation: %: oyiga max ~43.8 daqiqa downtime.

questions.question: Legacy migratsiya uchun Strangler Fig pattern nima?
questions.explanation: Monolit qismlarini API Gateway ortida bosqichma-bosqich yangi servislar bilan almashtirish, toki monolit butunlay o'chirilguncha.

questions.question: Sidecar, Ambassador va Adapter pattern'lari farqi.
questions.explanation: Sidecar: asosiy container'ni o'zgartirmasdan kengaytiradi (log shipper, metrics exporter).

questions.question: Mikroservislarda graceful degradation nima?
questions.explanation: Muhim bo'lmagan downstream servis yiqilganda tizim kamaytirilgan funksionallik bilan ishlashda davom etadi (masalan, recommendation engine yiqilsa statik "top sotuvlar" ko'rsatiladi).

questions.question: DB connection pooling nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: DB'ga doimiy ulanishlar pool'ini saqlash (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) — minglab client request'larni barqaror kichik backend ulanishlar ustida multiplex qilib, connection exhaustion'ning oldini olish.

questions.question: Distributed tranzaksiyalar uchun Saga pattern nima?
questions.explanation: Mikroservislar bo'ylab tranzaksiyani lokal tranzaksiyalar ketma-ketligi sifatida boshqarish; qadam fail bo'lsa oldingilari compensating tranzaksiya bilan bekor qilinadi.

questions.question: Transactional Outbox pattern nima?
questions.explanation: Event'ni biznes ma'lumot bilan bitta ACID tranzaksiyada "outbox" jadvaliga yozish; alohida jarayon (polling yoki CDC — Debezium) uni Kafka'ga publish qiladi. Dual-write muammosini hal qiladi (at-least-once).

questions.question: CQRS nima?
questions.explanation: O'qish va yozish operatsiyalarini alohida modellar (va ko'pincha alohida DB) ga ajratish — yozish (command) va tez o'qish (query) uchun mustaqil optimallashtirish.

questions.question: Event sourcing nima?
questions.explanation: Holat o'zgarishlari joriy qiymatni ustidan yozish o'rniga o'zgarmas event'larning append-only ketma-ketligi sifatida saqlanadi; joriy holat event'larni replay qilib olinadi.

questions.question: Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) nima?
questions.explanation: O'zgarishlar ma'lumot fayllariga qo'llanishidan oldin append-only log'ga diskka yoziladi — crash'da durability kafolatlanadi va replay bilan tiklanadi.

questions.question: Distributed consensus (Raft / Paxos) nima?
questions.explanation: Klasterdagi node'lar (etcd, Consul, CockroachDB) tarmoq bo'linishlariga qaramay holat bo'yicha kelishishiga imkon beruvchi algoritmlar; majority (quorum) talab qiladi.

questions.question: HA tizimlarda split-brain nima?
questions.explanation: Tarmoq bo'linishi klasterni ikki guruhga ajratadi va ikkalasi ham leader saylaydi — ma'lumot buziladi. Toq sonli node (3, 5, 7) va qat'iy majority quorum (⌊N/2⌋ + 1) talab qilib oldi olinadi; qo'shimcha — fencing.

questions.question: CAP teoremasi nima?
questions.explanation: Network partition (P) bo'lganda distributed store Consistency (C — hamma node bir xil ma'lumotni ko'radi) yoki Availability (A — har request xatosiz javob oladi) dan birini tanlashi kerak.

questions.question: PACELC teoremasi nima?
questions.explanation: CAP kengaytmasi: Partition bo'lsa — A yoki C; Else (normal holatda) — Latency yoki Consistency. Ya'ni partition bo'lmaganda ham consistency latency evaziga keladi.

questions.question: Head-of-Line (HoL) blocking nima?
questions.explanation: FIFO navbatda bitta yo'qolgan/kechikkan paket keyingi barcha paketlarni to'xtatib qo'yishi. HTTP/2 TCP ustida TCP darajasidagi HoL'ga duch keladi; HTTP/3 (QUIC, UDP ustida) stream'larni mustaqil qilib hal qiladi.

questions.question: Zero Trust microsegmentation nima?
questions.explanation: Klaster ichida har mikroservis orasida default-deny network policy va mTLS autentifikatsiya — "ichki tarmoq ishonchli" degan taxmin yo'q.

questions.question: Conway qonuni nima?
questions.explanation: Tashkilotlar o'z kommunikatsiya strukturasini aks ettiradigan tizimlar loyihalaydi. (Inverse Conway — kerakli arxitekturaga mos jamoalarni tuzish.)

questions.question: Continuous profiling nima?
questions.explanation: Production workload'lardan CPU, xotira va lock contention call stack'larini past overhead bilan doimiy yig'ish (ko'pincha eBPF orqali).

questions.question: Metrikalarda high cardinality nima?
questions.explanation: Unikal label qiymatlari juda ko'p bo'lgan metrika (user_id, email) — har kombinatsiya alohida time series, TSDB xotirasini tugatadi.

questions.question: Automated Canary Analysis (ACA) nima?
questions.explanation: Deploy paytida canary pod'larni baseline pod'lar bilan real vaqt metrikalari (error rate, p99 latency) bo'yicha statistik solishtirib, yomonlashsa avtomatik rollback.

questions.question: Enterprise SRE maturity model qanday bosqichlardan iborat?
questions.explanation: Reaktiv monitoring va qo'lda ticket.
